comment: She's the worst professor I had ever met. She does not understand what her students needed and teaches whatever that bored you.

Terrible terrible terrible. A professor who can't explain anything,spending most of her time talking about irrelevant things that has nothing to do with the thesis she's been teaching. Everyone gets a B+ first, than she started to give a uniformly A- at your second paper.

Professor Harbin is extremely disorganized and flighty. I found her class very boring, especially since it was pure lecture even though she said it would be discussion-based. She is also fairly pompous toward students.

You can barely recognize her handwriting. You won't be able to take notes from her writing. She can do nothing but to confuse you, no structural organization of class material. Dropped the class at the first week. Don't take her class or you will regret.

Class discussions can be boring at some times, but other times they evolve into interesting debates. You really have to pay attention to make sure you understand the material. Only coursework was 2 papers and short responses to readings plus an exam. She is very willing to help out with papers and to make sure you understand. Easy for an FSLT.
